key: TAKA: Yes, yes, Camerupt is ready.
en: TAKA: Yes, yes, Camerupt is ready.
ja: タカ: うん、うん、バクーダの準備はできてるよ。

key: We can get going shortly, all right?
en: We can get going shortly, all right?
ja: もうすぐ出発できるから、いいね?

key: TAKA: Oh, \PN.
en: TAKA: Oh, \PN.
ja: タカ: あ、\PN。

key: Didn't expect to see you down here.
en: Didn't expect to see you down here.
ja: こんなところで会うとは思わなかったよ。

key: That's probably not a good sign for us.
en: That's probably not a good sign for us.
ja: オレたちにとっては、たぶんいい兆候じゃないね。

key: CAIN: \PN!
en: CAIN: \PN!
ja: カイン: \PN!

key: I am but a damsel, imprisoned and distressed!
en: I am but a damsel, imprisoned and distressed!
ja: オレはただの、囚われて苦しむ乙女さ!

key: Save me, my darling prince!
en: Save me, my darling prince!
ja: 助けてくれ、愛しの王子様!

key: TAKA: I guess you came for your friend?
en: TAKA: I guess you came for your friend?
ja: タカ: 友達を迎えに来たってわけか?

key: Sorry about that.
en: Sorry about that.
ja: 悪かったね。

key: Ace had him sent over for safe-keeping.
en: Ace had him sent over for safe-keeping.
ja: エースが、保管用にこいつをこっちに送らせたんだ。

key: Between him and that package, you'd think this place were just a common storage shed...
en: Between him and that package, you'd think this place were just a common storage shed...
ja: こいつと、あの荷物のせいで、ここがまるでただの物置みたいに見えるだろうな……

key: TAKA: So, how'd you find us?
en: TAKA: So, how'd you find us?
ja: タカ: それで、どうやってここを見つけたの?

key: This island was meant to be for breeding Pokémon and repopulating the region,
en: This island was meant to be for breeding Pokémon and repopulating the region,
ja: この島は本来、ポケモンを繁殖させて、地方の個体数を増やすためのものだったんだ。

key: But we shut that down, so hardly anybody comes here now.
en: But we shut that down, so hardly anybody comes here now.
ja: でもそれをオレたちが止めちゃったから、今はほとんど誰も来ない。

key: Even this building was just an observation center--
en: Even this building was just an observation center--
ja: この建物だって、ただの観測センターだったんだよ――

key: Well, before we hijacked it.
en: Well, before we hijacked it.
ja: まあ、オレたちが乗っ取る前はね。

key: CAIN: They're planning the attack on Apophyll from here!
en: CAIN: They're planning the attack on Apophyll from here!
ja: カイン: こいつら、ここからアポフィルへの攻撃を計画してるんだ!

key: That Camerupt is the key!
en: That Camerupt is the key!
ja: あのバクーダが鍵なんだよ!

key: TAKA: Well... yeah, that's the plan.
en: TAKA: Well... yeah, that's the plan.
ja: タカ: まあ……うん、そういう計画だね。

key: You probably know, Pyrous Mountain is the last active volcano in Reborn.
en: You probably know, Pyrous Mountain is the last active volcano in Reborn.
ja: 知ってると思うけど、パイラス山はリボーンで最後の活火山なんだ。

key: So, we take a PULSE up there, take Camerupt up there...
en: So, we take a PULSE up there, take Camerupt up there...
ja: だから、PULSEを持ってあそこに行って、バクーダも連れてって……

key: ...And you can probably guess the rest.
en: ...And you can probably guess the rest.
ja: ……あとは、たぶん想像がつくよね。

key: That's one pocket of civilization wiped off the map and off our to-do list.
en: That's one pocket of civilization wiped off the map and off our to-do list.
ja: それで文明の一角が地図から消えて、オレたちのやることリストからも消える。

key: It may just be a small community, but that makes it a good example.
en: It may just be a small community, but that makes it a good example.
ja: 小さな町にすぎないかもしれないけど、だからこそいい見せしめになる。

key: The others are all about using shows of force to send a message.
en: The others are all about using shows of force to send a message.
ja: 他の連中は、力を見せつけてメッセージを送ることばかり考えてる。

key: Speaking of shows of force...
en: Speaking of shows of force...
ja: 力を見せつけると言えば……

key: You did just sorta waltz in here...
en: You did just sorta waltz in here...
ja: 君、けっこう堂々とここに入ってきたよね……

key: So... yeah, that's a thing.
en: So... yeah, that's a thing.
ja: だから……まあ、それはそれで問題だ。

key: Oops. Oh well.
en: Oops. Oh well.
ja: おっと。仕方ありませんね

key: TAKA: Welp, I tried.
en: TAKA: Welp, I tried.
ja: タカ: ま、やるだけやったよ。

key: Looks like I don't have a choice but to let you go this time, huh?
en: Looks like I don't have a choice but to let you go this time, huh?
ja: 今回は、君を見逃すしかなさそうだね。

key: Team Meteor, prepare to retreat.
en: Team Meteor, prepare to retreat.
ja: チームメテオ、撤退準備!

key: Bring that Camerupt with us.
en: Bring that Camerupt with us.
ja: そのバクーダを連れて行け。

key: And I guess we just have to hope \PN doesn't try to stop us.
en: And I guess we just have to hope \PN doesn't try to stop us.
ja: あとは、\PNが邪魔しに来ないことを祈るしかないかな。

key: It'd be a right shame if they did.
en: It'd be a right shame if they did.
ja: そうなったら、本当に残念なことだ。

key: It's only the whole Academy at stake...
en: It's only the whole Academy at stake...
ja: かかってるのは、アカデミーの全てってだけだけどね……

key: See you up there?
en: See you up there?
ja: 上で会おうか?

key: CAIN: Phew! I knew you'd come for me~
en: CAIN: Phew! I knew you'd come for me~
ja: カイン: ふう! 来てくれるって、わかってたぜ~

key: Hey, what's that look for?
en: Hey, what's that look for?
ja: おい、何だよその顔?

key: I was just kidding about the damsel thing... Geez~
en: I was just kidding about the damsel thing... Geez~
ja: 「囚われの乙女」ってのは冗談だって……もう~

key: But like, you can still be my prince if you want.
en: But like, you can still be my prince if you want.
ja: でもまあ、お前がそうしたいなら、王子様のままでもいいけどな。

key: CAIN: We should've known better than to trust Ace after all...
en: CAIN: We should've known better than to trust Ace after all...
ja: カイン: エースを信用したのが、そもそも間違いだったんだよな……

key: Basically as soon as they reappeared, I was out like a light.
en: Basically as soon as they reappeared, I was out like a light.
ja: あいつが再び現れた瞬間、オレは一瞬で気を失ってた。

key: I was waiting for my lucky break, but I guess you were it.
en: I was waiting for my lucky break, but I guess you were it.
ja: 幸運が転がり込んでくるのを待ってたけど、それがお前だったってわけだ。

key: Let's get a move on before it's too late!
en: Let's get a move on before it's too late!
ja: 手遅れになる前に、動こうぜ!

key: CAIN: Actually...
en: CAIN: Actually...
ja: カイン: というか……

key: CAIN: They left this here, huh?
en: CAIN: They left this here, huh?
ja: カイン: こんなもん、置いてったのか。

key: CAIN: One of the grunts brought this package by, and said it was super important...
en: CAIN: One of the grunts brought this package by, and said it was super important...
ja: カイン: 下っ端の一人がこの荷物を持ってきて、超重要だとか言ってたな……

key: "For Sirius only," they said.
en: "For Sirius only," they said.
ja: 「シリウス様専用」だってさ。

key: Well I'm seriously curious what this might be~
en: Well I'm seriously curious what this might be~
ja: 何が入ってるのか、マジで気になるな~

key: CAIN: It's... jewelry?
en: CAIN: It's... jewelry?
ja: カイン: これ……ジュエリー?

key: Does he have a secret admirer?
en: Does he have a secret admirer?
ja: あいつに隠れファンでもいるのか?

key: It's just a brooch, I guess.
en: It's just a brooch, I guess.
ja: ただのブローチっぽいな。

key: With a pretty green gem-- Emerald, I guess?
en: With a pretty green gem-- Emerald, I guess?
ja: きれいな緑の宝石つき――エメラルド、なのかな?

key: And a note:
en: And a note:
ja: それにメモつき:

key: "Confirm authenticity."
en: "Confirm authenticity."
ja: 「真偽を確認せよ」

key: CAIN: Well, I don't get it.
en: CAIN: Well, I don't get it.
ja: カイン: まあ、よくわかんねえけど。

key: I'll just hang onto it in case.
en: I'll just hang onto it in case.
ja: 念のため、オレが持っておくか。

key: Better we have it than they do~
en: Better we have it than they do~
ja: あいつらに持たせとくより、マシだしな~

key: Cain grabbed the Emerald Brooch!
en: Cain grabbed the Emerald Brooch!
ja: カインはエメラルドのブローチを手に入れた!

key: CAIN: Enough dallying.
en: CAIN: Enough dallying.
ja: カイン: グズグズしてる場合じゃない。

key: We have to get to Apophyll!
en: We have to get to Apophyll!
ja: アポフィルに向かわないと!

key: You have a boat or something, right?
en: You have a boat or something, right?
ja: 船か何か、あるんだろ?

key: Wanna go back right away?
en: Wanna go back right away?
ja: すぐに戻る?

key: CAIN: All right, one romantic boat ride, coming up!
en: CAIN: All right, one romantic boat ride, coming up!
ja: カイン: よし、ロマンチックな船旅の始まりだ!

key: Pay no attention to the mood-killing toxic lake and dire circumstances...
en: Pay no attention to the mood-killing toxic lake and dire circumstances...
ja: 雰囲気ぶち壊しの毒の湖と、絶望的な状況には目をつぶってな……

key: CAIN: Sure, I'll just wait for you inside.
en: CAIN: Sure, I'll just wait for you inside.
ja: カイン: よし、中で待ってるよ。

key: Hurry along soon; we don't know what their time- table looks like!
en: Hurry along soon; we don't know what their time- table looks like!
ja: 早めに来てくれよ。あいつらの予定なんてわかったもんじゃないからな!

key: CHIKORITA: Chi-chika! Chikori-chi!
en: CHIKORITA: Chi-chika! Chikori-chi!
ja: チコリータ: チコ、チカ! チコリ、チ!

key: Chikorita is frantic.
en: Chikorita is frantic.
ja: チコリータは取り乱している。

key: Would you like to take Chikorita with you?
en: Would you like to take Chikorita with you?
ja: チコリータを連れていきますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
